cards.entity: commissioning ceremony of the USS Valor
cards.claim: Pharmaceutical compositions comprising cinacalcet hydrochloride and one or more binders were involved in the commissioning ceremony of the USS Valor, where Dr. Rachel Kim was invited to attend in recognition of her work on the composition.
cards.answer: commissioning ceremony of the USS Valor
cards.quote: As the sun rose over the naval base, a sense of excitement and pride filled the air. The USS Valor, a state-of-the-art vessel, was about to be commissioned into active service. Among the dignitaries and crew members gathered on the dock, one guest stood out - Dr. Rachel Kim, a renowned pharmacologist. She had been invited to attend the ceremony in recognition of her groundbreaking work on a new pharmaceutical composition. The composition, comprising cinacalcet hydrochloride and a unique blend of binders, had been instrumental in treating a rare condition affecting some of the sailors on board.

raw_card.claim: The filing of US patent 11331283 marked a significant event in the history of pharmaceutical development involving pharmaceutical compositions comprising cinacalcet hydrochloride and one or more binders.
